/**
 * @name 2-hop call graph extraction from buggy function
 * @description Extracts all functions within 2 call-graph hops of a specified
 *              buggy function using name-based call resolution.
 * @kind problem
 * @id structfuse/call-graph-2hop
 * @problem.severity recommendation
 * @precision medium
 * @tags structfuse call-graph extraction
 */

import python

external string buggyFunctionName();
external string buggyFileName();

predicate isBuggyFunction(Function f) {
  f.getName() = buggyFunctionName() and
  f.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = buggyFileName()
}

predicate directCallEdge(Function caller, Function callee) {
  exists(Call call |
    call.getScope() = caller and
    (
      callee.getName() = call.getFunc().(Name).getId()
      or
      callee.getName() = call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName()
    )
  ) and
  caller != callee and
  caller.getEnclosingModule() = callee.getEnclosingModule()
}

predicate hop1(Function f, string direction) {
  exists(Function buggy |
    isBuggyFunction(buggy) and
    (
      directCallEdge(buggy, f) and direction = "callee"
      or
      directCallEdge(f, buggy) and direction = "caller"
    )
  )
}

predicate hop2(Function f, string direction) {
  exists(Function mid |
    hop1(mid, _) and
    (
      directCallEdge(mid, f) and direction = "callee"
      or
      directCallEdge(f, mid) and direction = "caller"
    ) and
    not isBuggyFunction(f) and
    not hop1(f, _)
  )
}

predicate inScope(Function f, int hopDistance, string direction) {
  isBuggyFunction(f) and hopDistance = 0 and direction = "origin"
  or
  hop1(f, direction) and hopDistance = 1
  or
  hop2(f, direction) and hopDistance = 2
}

from Function f, int hopDistance, string direction, File file, int startLine, int endLine
where
  inScope(f, hopDistance, direction) and
  file = f.getLocation().getFile() and
  startLine = f.getLocation().getStartLine() and
  endLine = f.getLocation().getEndLine()
select
  f.getName() as target_func,
  hopDistance as hop_distance,
  direction,
  file.getRelativePath() as file_path,
  startLine as start_line,
  endLine as end_line
QLEOF

/**
 * @name Scope-bounded inter-procedural data-flow analysis
 * @description Tracks data-flow within 2 call-graph hops of the buggy function.
 *              Sources and sinks are restricted BEFORE evaluation.
 * @kind path-problem
 * @id structfuse/bounded-dataflow
 * @problem.severity recommendation
 * @precision medium
 * @tags structfuse data-flow inter-procedural
 * @timeout 300
 * @ram 8192
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

external string buggyFunctionName();
external string buggyFileName();

predicate isBuggyFunction(Function f) {
  f.getName() = buggyFunctionName() and
  f.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = buggyFileName()
}

predicate directCallEdge(Function caller, Function callee) {
  exists(Call call |
    call.getScope() = caller and
    (
      callee.getName() = call.getFunc().(Name).getId()
      or
      callee.getName() = call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName()
    )
  ) and
  caller != callee and
  caller.getEnclosingModule() = callee.getEnclosingModule()
}

predicate hop1(Function f) {
  exists(Function buggy |
    isBuggyFunction(buggy) and
    (directCallEdge(buggy, f) or directCallEdge(f, buggy))
  )
}

predicate hop2(Function f) {
  exists(Function mid |
    hop1(mid) and
    (directCallEdge(mid, f) or directCallEdge(f, mid)) and
    not isBuggyFunction(f) and
    not hop1(f)
  )
}

predicate inScopeFunction(Function f) {
  isBuggyFunction(f) or hop1(f) or hop2(f)
}

module BoundedFlowConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node node) {
    exists(Function f |
      inScopeFunction(f) and
      node.getScope() = f and
      (
        node instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
        or
        node instanceof DataFlow::CfgNode
      )
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node node) {
    exists(Function f |
      inScopeFunction(f) and
      node.getScope() = f
    )
  }
}

module BoundedFlow = DataFlow::Global<BoundedFlowConfig>;

import BoundedFlow::PathGraph

from BoundedFlow::PathNode source, BoundedFlow::PathNode sink, int pathLength
where
  BoundedFlow::flowPath(source, sink) and
  pathLength =
    if source.getNode().getScope() = sink.getNode().getScope()
    then 0
    else if exists(Function sf, Function tf |
      sf = source.getNode().getScope() and
      tf = sink.getNode().getScope() and
      (directCallEdge(sf, tf) or directCallEdge(tf, sf))
    )
    then 1
    else 2
select
  sink.getNode(),
  source,
  sink,
  source.getNode().getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() as source_file,
  source.getNode().getScope().(Function).getName() as source_func,
  source.getNode().getLocation().getStartLine() as source_line,
  sink.getNode().getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() as sink_file,
  sink.getNode().getScope().(Function).getName() as sink_func,
  sink.getNode().getLocation().getStartLine() as sink_line,
  pathLength as path_length
QLEOF

/**
 * @name 2-hop call graph extraction from buggy function
 * @description Extracts all functions within 2 call-graph hops of a specified
 *              buggy function. Uses name-based and attribute-based call resolution.
 * @kind problem
 * @id structfuse/call-graph-2hop
 * @problem.severity recommendation
 * @precision medium
 * @tags structfuse call-graph extraction
 */

import python

external string buggyFunctionName();
external string buggyFileName();

predicate isBuggyFunction(Function f) {
  f.getName() = buggyFunctionName() and
  f.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = buggyFileName()
}

predicate directCallEdge(Function caller, Function callee) {
  exists(Call call |
    call.getScope() = caller and
    (
      // Direct name call: func()
      callee.getName() = call.getFunc().(Name).getId() and
      caller.getEnclosingModule() = callee.getEnclosingModule()
      or
      // Attribute call: obj.method() — match by name within the same package
      exists(string methodName |
        methodName = call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() and
        callee.getName() = methodName and
        caller.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().prefix(
          caller.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().indexOf("/")
        ) =
        callee.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().prefix(
          callee.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().indexOf("/")
        )
      )
    )
  ) and
  caller != callee
}

predicate hop1(Function f, string direction) {
  exists(Function buggy |
    isBuggyFunction(buggy) and
    (
      directCallEdge(buggy, f) and direction = "callee"
      or
      directCallEdge(f, buggy) and direction = "caller"
    )
  )
}

predicate hop2(Function f, string direction) {
  exists(Function mid |
    hop1(mid, _) and
    (
      directCallEdge(mid, f) and direction = "callee"
      or
      directCallEdge(f, mid) and direction = "caller"
    ) and
    not isBuggyFunction(f) and
    not hop1(f, _)
  )
}

predicate inScope(Function f, int hopDistance, string direction) {
  isBuggyFunction(f) and hopDistance = 0 and direction = "origin"
  or
  hop1(f, direction) and hopDistance = 1
  or
  hop2(f, direction) and hopDistance = 2
}

from Function f, int hopDistance, string direction, File file, int startLine, int endLine
where
  inScope(f, hopDistance, direction) and

  startLine = f.getLocation().getStartLine() and
  endLine = f.getLocation().getEndLine()
select
  f.getName() as target_func,
  hopDistance as hop_distance,

  file.getRelativePath() as file_path,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MVP Phase 1: CodeQL pilot on 10 repos + H2 sanity check."""

import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/mvp_data")
RESULTS_DIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/mvp_results")
CODEQL_QUERIES = Path("/root/structfuse/extraction/codeql_queries")
CALL_GRAPH_QL = CODEQL_QUERIES / "call_graph.ql"
DATAFLOW_QL = CODEQL_QUERIES / "bounded_dataflow.ql"
TIMEOUT = 300
RAM = 8192


def clone_repo(repo, dest, commit="main"):
    if os.path.exists(dest):
        print(f"  [skip] {dest} exists")
        if commit not in ("main", "master"):
            subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", commit], cwd=dest,
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        return True
    url = f"https://github.com/{repo}.git"
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "--depth", "200", url, dest],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300, check=True)
        if commit not in ("main", "master"):
            subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", commit], cwd=dest,
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  [error] clone: {e}")
        return False


def find_buggy_function(repo_dir, buggy_file, buggy_function):
    import ast
    target = os.path.join(repo_dir, buggy_file)
    if not os.path.exists(target):
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(repo_dir):
            for f in files:
                if f == os.path.basename(buggy_file):
                    target = os.path.join(root, f)
                    buggy_file = os.path.relpath(target, repo_dir)
                    break
        if not os.path.exists(target):
            return None, None
    try:
        with open(target, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            source = f.read()
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except SyntaxError:
        return buggy_file, buggy_function

    all_funcs = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            all_funcs.append(node.name)
            if node.name == buggy_function:
                return buggy_file, buggy_function

    candidates = [f for f in all_funcs if not f.startswith("_")]
    if candidates:
        return buggy_file, candidates[0]
    if all_funcs:
        return buggy_file, all_funcs[0]
    return buggy_file, buggy_function


def create_codeql_db(repo_dir, db_path):
    start = time.time()
    cmd = ["codeql", "database", "create", db_path, "--language=python",
           "--source-root", repo_dir, "--overwrite", "--threads=0"]
    try:
        subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600, check=True)
        return True, time.time() - start
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  [error] db create: {e}")
        return False, time.time() - start


def run_query(db_path, query_path, output_csv, buggy_function, buggy_file):
    start = time.time()
    ext_dir = os.path.dirname(output_csv)
    func_file = os.path.join(ext_dir, "buggyFunctionName.csv")
    file_file = os.path.join(ext_dir, "buggyFileName.csv")
    with open(func_file, "w") as f:
        f.write(f'"{buggy_function}"\n')
    with open(file_file, "w") as f:
        f.write(f'"{buggy_file}"\n')

    bqrs = output_csv + ".bqrs"
    cmd = ["codeql", "query", "run", "--database", db_path, "--output", bqrs,
           f"--timeout={TIMEOUT}", f"--ram={RAM}", "--threads=0",
           f"--external=buggyFunctionName={func_file}",
           f"--external=buggyFileName={file_file}",
           str(query_path)]
    timed_out = False
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True,
                           timeout=TIMEOUT + 120, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["codeql", "bqrs", "decode", "--format=csv",
                        "--output", output_csv, bqrs],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, check=True)
        return True, time.time() - start, False
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return False, time.time() - start, True
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        timed_out = "timeout" in str(e.stderr + e.stdout).lower()
        return False, time.time() - start, timed_out


def parse_call_graph_csv(csv_path):
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        header = True
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            if header:
                header = False
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 6:
                results.append({
                    "target_func": parts[0],
                    "hop_distance": int(parts[1]) if parts[1].isdigit() else 0,
                    "direction": parts[2],
                    "file_path": parts[3],
                })
    return results


def parse_dataflow_csv(csv_path):
    results = []
    if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
        return results
    with open(csv_path) as f:
        header = True
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            if header:
                header = False
                continue
            parts = [p.strip().strip('"') for p in line.split(",")]
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                src_file = parts[0] if parts[0].endswith(".py") else ""
                sink_file = ""
                for p in parts:
                    if p.endswith(".py") and p != src_file:
                        sink_file = p
                        break
                results.append({"source_file": src_file, "sink_file": sink_file})
    return results


def get_connected_files(call_graph, dataflow, buggy_file):
    files = {buggy_file}
    for cg in call_graph:
        fp = cg.get("file_path", "")
        if fp:
            files.add(fp)
    for df in dataflow:
        for key in ("source_file", "sink_file"):
            fp = df.get(key, "")
            if fp:
                files.add(fp)
    return files


def get_all_py_files(repo_dir):
    files = []
    for root, dirs, filenames in os.walk(repo_dir):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".") and d != "__pycache__"]
        for f in filenames:
            if f.endswith(".py"):
                files.append(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), repo_dir))
    return files


def h2_analysis(results_list):
    from scipy import stats
    c_hits = c_total = d_hits = d_total = 0
    per_inst = []
    for r in results_list:
        connected = r.get("connected_files", set())
        gold = set(r.get("gold_files", []))
        all_f = set(r.get("all_py_files", []))
        disconnected = all_f - connected
        if not gold or not connected:
            continue
        ch = len(gold & connected)
        ct = len(connected)
        dh = len(gold & disconnected)
        dt = len(disconnected)
        c_hits += ch; c_total += ct; d_hits += dh; d_total += dt
        per_inst.append({
            "instance_id": r["instance_id"],
            "gold_files": list(gold),
            "connected_count": ct, "disconnected_count": dt,
            "gold_in_connected": ch, "gold_in_disconnected": dh,
            "coverage_connected": ch / max(len(gold), 1),
        })

    table = [[c_hits, c_total - c_hits], [d_hits, d_total - d_hits]]
    try:
        odds, pval = stats.fisher_exact(table, alternative="greater")
    except Exception:
        odds, pval = float("nan"), float("nan")

    cov_c = c_hits / max(c_total, 1)
    cov_d = d_hits / max(d_total, 1)
    return {
        "coverage_connected": cov_c, "coverage_disconnected": cov_d,
        "fisher_odds_ratio": odds, "fisher_p_value": pval,
        "connected_hits": c_hits, "connected_total": c_total,
        "disconnected_hits": d_hits, "disconnected_total": d_total,
        "h2_pass": pval < 0.05 and cov_c > cov_d,
        "per_instance": per_inst,
    }


def load_swebench_instances():
    try:
        from datasets import load_dataset
        print("Loading SWE-bench Lite...")
        ds = load_dataset("princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Lite", split="test")
        print(f"  Loaded {len(ds)} instances")
        by_repo = defaultdict(list)
        for item in ds:
            by_repo[item["repo"]].append(item)

        selected = []
        preferred = [
            "pallets/flask", "psf/requests", "pytest-dev/pytest",
            "mwaskom/seaborn", "pylint-dev/pylint", "pydata/xarray",
            "astropy/astropy", "sphinx-doc/sphinx", "matplotlib/matplotlib",
            "scikit-learn/scikit-learn", "Textualize/rich", "encode/httpx",
            "pydantic/pydantic", "marshmallow-code/marshmallow",
        ]
        for repo in preferred:
            if repo in by_repo and len(selected) < 10:
                item = by_repo[repo][0]
                inst = _swebench_to_instance(item)
                if inst:
                    selected.append(inst)
        for repo, items in sorted(by_repo.items(), key=lambda x: len(x[1])):
            if len(selected) >= 10:
                break
            if repo in preferred:
                continue
            inst = _swebench_to_instance(items[0])
            if inst:
                selected.append(inst)
        return selected[:10]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Failed: {e}")
        return None


def _swebench_to_instance(item):
    patch = item.get("patch", "")
    gold_files = []
    for line in patch.split("\n"):
        if line.startswith("--- a/") or line.startswith("+++ b/"):
            fpath = line.split("/", 1)[1] if "/" in line else ""
            if fpath and fpath != "/dev/null" and fpath not in gold_files:
                gold_files.append(fpath)
    if not gold_files:
        return None
    buggy_function = None
    for line in patch.split("\n"):
        if line.startswith("@@"):
            m = re.search(r'@@.*@@\s+(?:def|class)\s+(\w+)', line)
            if m:
                buggy_function = m.group(1)
                break
    if not buggy_function:
        buggy_function = "__init__"
    return {
        "instance_id": item["instance_id"],
        "repo": item["repo"],
        "base_commit": item["base_commit"],
        "buggy_file": gold_files[0],
        "buggy_function": buggy_function,
        "gold_files": gold_files,
    }


def main():
    BASE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print("=" * 60)
    print("MVP Phase 1: CodeQL Pilot + H2 Verification")
    print("=" * 60)

    real = load_swebench_instances()
    instances = real if real else []
    if not instances:
        print("ERROR: Could not load instances")
        return
    print(f"Using {len(instances)} SWE-bench Lite instances")

    # Clone
    print("\n--- Cloning repos ---")
    for inst in instances:
        repo_dir = str(BASE_DIR / inst["repo"].replace("/", "__"))
        inst["repo_dir"] = repo_dir
        print(f"Cloning {inst['repo']}...")
        inst["clone_ok"] = clone_repo(inst["repo"], repo_dir, inst.get("base_commit", "main"))

    # CodeQL
    print("\n--- Running CodeQL ---")
    results = []
    for inst in instances:
        if not inst.get("clone_ok"):
            print(f"[skip] {inst['instance_id']}: clone failed")
            continue
        repo_dir = inst["repo_dir"]
        iid = inst["instance_id"]
        print(f"\nProcessing {iid}...")

        bf, bfunc = find_buggy_function(repo_dir, inst["buggy_file"], inst["buggy_function"])
        if bf is None:
            print(f"  [skip] buggy file not found")
            continue
        inst["buggy_file"] = bf
        inst["buggy_function"] = bfunc
        print(f"  buggy: {bf}:{bfunc}")

        work_dir = RESULTS_DIR / iid
        work_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        db_path = str(work_dir / "codeql_db")
        if os.path.exists(db_path):
            print(f"  [skip] DB exists")
            db_ok, db_time = True, 0.0
        else:
            print(f"  Creating CodeQL database...")
            db_ok, db_time = create_codeql_db(repo_dir, db_path)
            print(f"  DB: {'OK' if db_ok else 'FAIL'} ({db_time:.1f}s)")

        result = {
            "instance_id": iid, "repo": inst["repo"],
            "buggy_file": bf, "buggy_function": bfunc,
            "gold_files": inst.get("gold_files", []),
            "db_creation_time": round(db_time, 1), "db_ok": db_ok,
        }

        if not db_ok:
            result.update({"cg_ok": False, "df_ok": False, "cg_time": 0, "df_time": 0,
                           "cg_timeout": False, "df_timeout": False,
                           "connected_files": set(), "all_py_files": get_all_py_files(repo_dir)})
            results.append(result)
            continue

        # Call graph
        cg_csv = str(work_dir / "call_graph.csv")
        print(f"  Running call_graph.ql...")
        cg_ok, cg_time, cg_to = run_query(db_path, str(CALL_GRAPH_QL), cg_csv, bfunc, bf)
        print(f"  CG: {'OK' if cg_ok else ('TIMEOUT' if cg_to else 'FAIL')} ({cg_time:.1f}s)")
        result.update({"cg_ok": cg_ok, "cg_time": round(cg_time, 1), "cg_timeout": cg_to})

        # Dataflow
        df_csv = str(work_dir / "bounded_dataflow.csv")
        print(f"  Running bounded_dataflow.ql...")
        df_ok, df_time, df_to = run_query(db_path, str(DATAFLOW_QL), df_csv, bfunc, bf)
        print(f"  DF: {'OK' if df_ok else ('TIMEOUT' if df_to else 'FAIL')} ({df_time:.1f}s)")
        result.update({"df_ok": df_ok, "df_time": round(df_time, 1), "df_timeout": df_to})

        cg = parse_call_graph_csv(cg_csv) if cg_ok else []
        df = parse_dataflow_csv(df_csv) if df_ok else []
        connected = get_connected_files(cg, df, bf)
        all_py = get_all_py_files(repo_dir)
        result.update({
            "cg_functions": len(cg), "df_paths": len(df),
            "connected_files": connected,
            "reachable_file_count": len(connected),
            "total_py_files": len(all_py), "all_py_files": all_py,
        })
        results.append(result)
        print(f"  Connected: {len(connected)}/{len(all_py)} files")

    # Summary
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("RESULTS SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 60)

    total = len(results)
    any_to = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("cg_timeout") or r.get("df_timeout"))
    to_rate = any_to / max(total, 1)

    cg_times = [r["cg_time"] for r in results if r.get("cg_ok")]
    df_times = [r["df_time"] for r in results if r.get("df_ok")]
    reachable = [r.get("reachable_file_count", 0) for r in results if r.get("cg_ok") or r.get("df_ok")]

    print(f"\nTotal: {total}")
    print(f"Timeout rate: {to_rate:.1%}")
    print(f"Phase 1a: {'PASS' if to_rate < 0.3 else 'FAIL'}")
    if cg_times:
        print(f"CG time: mean={sum(cg_times)/len(cg_times):.1f}s, max={max(cg_times):.1f}s")
    if df_times:
        print(f"DF time: mean={sum(df_times)/len(df_times):.1f}s, max={max(df_times):.1f}s")
    if reachable:
        print(f"Reachable files: mean={sum(reachable)/len(reachable):.1f}")

    print(f"\n{'Instance':<40} {'DB':<6} {'CG':<8} {'DF':<8} {'Reach':<6} {'Status'}")
    print("-" * 80)
    for r in results:
        st = "OK" if r["db_ok"] and not r.get("cg_timeout") and not r.get("df_timeout") else (
            "DB_FAIL" if not r["db_ok"] else "TIMEOUT")
        print(f"{r['instance_id']:<40} {r['db_creation_time']:<6.0f} {r.get('cg_time',0):<8.1f} "
              f"{r.get('df_time',0):<8.1f} {r.get('reachable_file_count',0):<6} {st}")

    # H2
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("H2 SANITY CHECK")
    print("=" * 60)
    h2 = h2_analysis(results)
    print(f"Coverage connected:    {h2['coverage_connected']:.6f}")
    print(f"Coverage disconnected: {h2['coverage_disconnected']:.6f}")
    print(f"Fisher OR: {h2['fisher_odds_ratio']:.2f}, p={h2['fisher_p_value']:.4f}")
    print(f"H2: {'PASS' if h2['h2_pass'] else 'FAIL'}")

    for pi in h2.get("per_instance", []):
        print(f"  {pi['instance_id']}: gold_in_conn={pi['gold_in_connected']}/{len(pi['gold_files'])}, "
              f"conn={pi['connected_count']}, disc={pi['disconnected_count']}")

    # Save
    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total": total, "timeout_rate": round(to_rate, 3),
            "phase1a_pass": to_rate < 0.3,
            "mean_cg_time": round(sum(cg_times)/max(len(cg_times),1), 1) if cg_times else 0,
            "mean_df_time": round(sum(df_times)/max(len(df_times),1), 1) if df_times else 0,
            "mean_reachable": round(sum(reachable)/max(len(reachable),1), 1) if reachable else 0,
        },
        "h2": {k: v for k, v in h2.items() if k != "per_instance"},
        "h2_per_instance": h2.get("per_instance", []),
        "per_repo": [{k: (list(v) if isinstance(v, set) else v)
                      for k, v in r.items() if k != "all_py_files"}
                     for r in results],
    }
    rp = RESULTS_DIR / "mvp_phase1_report.json"
    with open(rp, "w") as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2, default=str)
    print(f"\nReport: {rp}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print(f"Phase 1a (timeout <30%): {'PASS' if to_rate < 0.3 else 'FAIL'}")
    print(f"H2 (connected > disconnected): {'PASS' if h2['h2_pass'] else 'FAIL'}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
